name: Specters Factory 1
detailed_description:
Your parents went to work… and never came home.

In KEY CO., you play as a child left alone after your parents vanished without a trace during their night shift at the local factory — a towering, rust-covered complex known as Key Co. The police stopped looking. The neighbors whispered. But you know something is wrong.

Driven by fear and the desperate hope of finding answers, you sneak into the abandoned factory. What you uncover inside goes far beyond missing persons. The halls are alive. The machinery remembers. And something watches from the shadows.

This is not just a place of work. It’s a trap built over decades — and now it wants you, too.

Features

  • Explore the dark secrets of Key Co.
    Navigate a massive, decaying industrial complex filled with locked doors, hidden passages, and chilling environmental storytelling.

  • Immersive first-person horror
    Experience fear through the eyes of a child — limited strength, no weapons, just instinct, stealth, and courage.

  • Puzzles and survival elements
    Unlock the truth piece by piece through cryptic notes, machinery puzzles, and dangerous encounters.

  • Atmospheric sound and lighting
    Use light and sound to your advantage — or risk drawing the attention of what still lurks in the factory.

  • A haunting story
    Uncover the fate of your parents, the twisted purpose of Key Co., and the line between human invention and inhuman obsession.

You came looking for your family. But something else found you first.
